[[File:HeartofDathomir.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Heart of Dathomir nebula in Dathomir's Vitality]]
'''Dathomir's Vitality''' was a quadrant of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]. It contained the dangerous red-pulsating [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] known as the [[Heart of Dathomir]]. It was believed by the adepts of the [[Dark Veil Order]] that a powerful rage existed within the living nebula. Its power was held to be so great that only the sacrifice of sentient beings could calm its rage. Pilots of the Dark Veil Order controlled Dathomir's Vitality and ambushed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] moving through the quadrant in order to sacrifice the captured beings to the Heart of Dathomir.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66852&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dathomir System}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dathomir's Vitality appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dathomir's Vitality was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly stated that Dathomir's Vitality was a knot of rage located at the center of the Heart of Dathomir nebula.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|29|Heart of Dathomir}}</ref> In the game, Dathomir's Vitality was just the name of the space quadrant containing the nebula.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
